source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.9, printed pages 106-107.

blocks.text: Liquid ko garam karte jayein to us ka vapour pressure barhta jata hai. Ek waqt aata hai jab liquid ka vapour pressure bahar ke (atmospheric ya external) pressure ke barabar ho jata hai; isi temperature par liquid boil hona (ubalna) shuru karta hai. Wajah: liquid ke andar banne wale vapour ke bubbles (bulbulon) ka andar ka pressure surface par atmospheric pressure se zyada ho jata hai, is liye bubbles liquid se bahar aa kar surface par phat jate hain. Boiling point par bubbles ka constant stream (musalsal silsila) nikalta rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Frame wala graph: vapour pressure (200 se 800, 760 bhi likha) temperature (0 se 100 degree C) ke muqable, har 20 degree par khari lines aur 760 par ek leti hui line. Chaar curves daen taraf oopar jate hain: Diethyl ether (taqreeban 200 se shuru), Ethyl alcohol (ethanol), Water (pani) aur Ethylene glycol jo neeche hi rehta hai. 760 line ke oopar 'Normal boiling points' ke neeche 34.6 C, 78.3 C aur 100 C wahan ishara karte hain jahan ether, ethanol aur pani ke curves 760 ko kat-te hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.9: Chaar aam liquids ka vapour pressure (torr) temperature ke saath (kitab ki Figure 5.9 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text: Liquid garam karne se us ke molecules ki kinetic energy barhti hai aur temperature barhta hai. Boiling point par molecules ki kinetic energy maximum (apni had) par pohanch jati hai; is ke baad aur heat dene se temperature nahi barhta. Yeh extra heat intermolecular forces torne aur liquid ko vapour banane mein lagti hai. Aam liquids ke 1 atmosphere par boiling points Table 5.4 (topic 5.9.1) mein hain.

Figure 5.9 pani, ethyl alcohol, ethylene glycol aur diethyl ether ka vapour pressure temperature ke saath dikhati hai. Graphs batate hain ke sea level (samandar ki satah) par har liquid tab ubalta hai jab us ka vapour pressure 760 torr ho jaye: diethyl ether 34.6 °C, ethanol 78.3 °C aur pani 100 °C par.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph par 760 torr ki seedhi line dekhein: jo curve is line ko pehle (kam temperature par) chhoo leta hai, woh liquid pehle ubalta hai. Ether ki forces sab se kamzor hain, is liye woh sab se pehle ubalta hai; ethylene glycol ki sab se mazboot, woh 100 °C se bhi upar ubalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ubalte pani ka temperature tez aag par bhi 100 °C hi kyun rehta hai?
blocks.explanation: Boiling point par molecules ki kinetic energy us pressure par apni had par hai. Extra heat molecules ko tez karne ke bajaye intermolecular forces torne (liquid ko vapour banane) mein lagti hai, is liye jab tak sara pani ubal na jaye temperature wahi rehta hai.

items: Liquid tab ubalta hai jab us ka vapour pressure bahar ke pressure ke barabar ho jaye; andar bubbles ban kar surface par phatte hain.
Boiling point par extra heat temperature nahi barhati, forces torti hai; 760 torr par ether 34.6, ethanol 78.3, pani 100 °C.
